_comment: Interior kit technical rules (step 2 of the author's kit brief, 26. 9. 2026). Read by the part builders (step 4), the kit checks in test_ship_geometry (step 5) and the kit manifest (step 6). Metres, Blender axes (+X forward, +Y left, +Z up), scale 1. Human-readable version: .claude/skills/ship-interior/SKILL.md, 'Interiérový kit: mřížka a technická pravidla'.

grid._comment: Plan grid 0.3 m (module lengths 0.3 / 0.6 / 0.9 / 1.2, portal pitch 1.2 = portal 0.3 + walls 0.9); vertical grid 0.1 m. Fillers 0.1 / 0.2 only where a hull forces a width off the grid.

sections._comment: Clear width between the wall panel faces at the floor. Wall: plinth to z 0.1 (45 deg chamfer, floor light strip), vertical to 'vertical_to', then a 3:4 slope (36.9 deg, the design language's ~35 deg on the grid) rising 'slope_rise' with a horizontal inset of 0.75 x rise, then the cove with its light strip up to the ceiling.

S.name: servisní průlez
S._portal: flush: the character capsule is 0.84 m wide

zones._comment: Depths relative to the wall panel face (the room boundary from the layout). Behind the face: structure up to structure_depth (then the hull liner); in front: fittings, portals.

shadow_gap._comment: each module carries half the gap on its edges (inset 0.004) over a dark seal strip - no see-through at joints

pivots._comment: Where the origin sits per category. 'run' parts follow the corridor (+X = run direction); 'faced' parts look at +X (their front / face normal).

run.origin: start of the module, on the section centreline, at floor level (z 0); +X along the run

wall.origin: bottom corner on the panel face plane, at floor level; face normal +X, width along +Y (0..W)

corner.origin: inner corner where the two panel face planes meet, at floor level; faces +X and +Y

faced.origin: centre of the mounting face (wall-mounted: on the wall face; floor-standing: on the floor under the back edge); front = +X

light._comment: socket X = light direction (spot), parameters per socket in the kit manifest: type point|spot|rect, role warm|cool|signal|emergency, cd, radius_m, cone_deg, megalights_shadow

decal._comment: socket X = surface normal, Y = decal up; manifest tags: section_number, hazard, label, arrow, service

mount._comment: where a fitting may attach (extinguisher, display arm, handrail bracket)

naming._mesh_example: SM_Kit_Wall_Grille06W_B = wall module, grille, 0.6 m, section W, variant B (size in decimetres)

palettes._comment: Linear colours per slot role; a ship picks one with 'kit_maker' in its setup (MI_Kit_<Maker>_<Role>). Kestrel Dynamics is a proposal.

texel_density._comment: px per metre. Trim-mapped geometry (edges, lips, seams, trims) on the kit trim sheet; big surfaces tile triplanar in world space (no UVs to keep even); decals from the decal library.

tri_budget._comment: LOD0 triangles, non-Nanite. Per-metre entries scale with the part's length.

lod._comment: Walls, floors, ceilings, portals: LOD0 only. Consoles, furniture, fittings: automatic LOD1 at 50 % from screen size 0.25.

collision._comment: Simple UCX boxes per module, never complex-as-simple. Character capsule radius 0.42 m, height 1.92 m (PlayerCharacter.cpp): the clear width anywhere, portals included, must stay >= 0.9 m and the clear height >= 2.0 m.
collision.Wall: one box: face plane to the structure depth, full height
collision.Floor: one box under the plate top
collision.Ceiling: one box above the ceiling plane
collision.Portal: boxes for the protruding frame legs and head
collision.Door: frame boxes; the leaf has its own box that moves with it
collision.Fitting: none (handrails, signs, small boxes) or one box when it can be climbed or stood on

nanite._comment: Kept off (checked again 26. 9. 2026, Docs/Reviews/2026-09-26_kit_nanite_check): with Nanite the Wayfarer interior lost its thin parts (display bezels, control module housings) and its shapes coarsened in the pilot's view; ray-traced MegaLights shadows want the exact non-Nanite geometry; the interior flies with the camera (WORKFLOW 9.2 a).
